analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 2 sessions. RSI at 51.0 continues to consolidate in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram at 1787.5244 shows sustained improvement. Volume ratio increased to 1.51 compared to the 5-day average, but directionality is absent around the Bollinger Band middle line. Weekly ADX at 36.5 confirms a clear trend, but daily ADX at 19.8 indicates a non-trending phase. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see stance.
